preconditions.description: Attacker must hold Touch tokens to set approvals
Contract must be in unrestricted mode (unrestricted == true)

exploit_hint: The approve function requires current allowance to be 0 OR new value to be 0. To exploit the race condition: (1) Attacker sets approval to non-zero value for spender, (2) Attacker attempts to change approval to different non-zero value without first setting to 0, (3) This forces a two-step approval change (approve to 0, then approve to new value), creating a window where spender could potentially front-run and spend tokens. Test by calling approve(spender, X) then approve(spender, Y) where both X and Y are non-zero - the second call should revert, demonstrating the protection mechanism.
